reviewers.summary: The manifest and request gate enforce an exact swedencentral match. The validation test leaves two formerly allowed regions uncovered, so it would not catch their accidental reintroduction.

findingList.message: The AC: MODEL-REGION-01 test omits the previously allowed regions westus and westus3; add both to the rejection cases.

evidence.codePathTraced: Region_is_fixed_to_sweden_central supplies the rejected values to ApprovedModelManifest.Validate, but its list omits westus and westus3, which were in the previous RegionPattern allowlist.
evidence.failureScenario: If the validation regex accidentally permits westus or westus3 again, this test still passes, so AC: MODEL-REGION-01's test does not verify rejection of every previously allowed region.
